summary: Cabin on a Ghost Wilderness foothill; the 1952 original replaced Black Rock, the register dates the present cabin to 1972, and it is reported staffed in 2020.

access.note: Alberta says the public may not climb lookout towers and lookout dwellings are for private use. A 2023 Alberta Wilderness Association group was given a guided tour of the lookout. The register codes the site as drive access; the 2020 trip report describes a gate near the trailhead.

visit.trail_note: A gate near the trailhead keeps off-road vehicles out. The public may not climb the lookout tower.

events.note: Original lookout, per the 2020 trip report, built to replace the Black Rock lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2020 trip report gives 350 m of climb; the 2023 Alberta Wilderness Association account gives 300 m. Both are reported with their years.

The register codes the site as drive access, while the 2020 trip report describes a gate near the trailhead that stops off-road vehicles. The story reports the gate and does not say that cars can drive up.

notes_for_editor: Register values (YEAR_CONSTRUCTED 1972, TOWER_HEIGHT 5.0, ELEVATION 1906.6, ACCESS_MODE drive, ACTIVE Y) come from the same public query on the Alberta lookout layer as the other two; that layer's metadata labels the dataset Protected, so the editor should confirm these values may be published. The 1952 original and the 1972 register year are not reconciled by any public source; the story says the register date is later than the original and does not describe a rebuild. The 1950 Black Rock closure and the 1952 Mockingbird date come from two different sources and do not line up cleanly. A forum post that places the current lookout in the early 1970s was not used: the fetch returned 403. A forum post on staffing months and the Mary Theresa Kelly memoir came up in search but were not read, so they are not used. The brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source read; it is recorded as restricted.
